basis: Fixed exploratory engineering settings: temporal median rejects a single bad-pose out-and-back pair; dwell confirmation and hysteresis reduce state flicker. No label-derived calibration or clinical interpretation.
start_estimate: first above-start median sample in the confirmed run; confirmation time recorded separately
end_estimate: first below-stop median sample in the confirmed run; confirmation time recorded separately
initial_state: unknown until a full low-speed dwell establishes a baseline; activity before baseline has unknown start
clip_end: active event keeps end=null; never close it using last video time
invalid_policy: no interpolation or bridging across invalid matrices, nonmonotonic or oversized time gaps
